1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Classify every spec CSR by its hybrid-handoff transport disposition.
3	
4	The OFFLINE mirror of the wire-format transport set. It reads the spec inventory
5	snapshot (tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv, produced by extract_csr_inventory.py)
6	and assigns each CSR a disposition under the supported envelope: bare-metal,
7	single-hart, M-mode or M+U-mode, trap-free ROI.
8	
9	The policy here must match what include/hybrid/state_abi.h actually transports.
10	The guard test (tests/andes_csr/test_csr_coverage_complete.*) cross-checks the
11	two, so a CSR added to the ABI without a matching disposition (or vice versa)
12	fails CI -- the "nothing missed" flywheel.
13	
14	Dispositions:
15	  TRANSPORT_NOW  already carried in hybrid_state_v1
16	  NEW            writable M-mode plain state -- expansion target
17	  NEW_TRIG       debug-trigger CSR (shares the Debug Module; transported guarded)
18	  NEW_UDELTA     U-mode Andes control; transported, exercised only in M+U
19	  CONST_RO       read-only config/info -- engine derives it; nothing to exchange
20	  EXCL_RV32      RV32 high-half shadow -- irrelevant on RV64
21	  EXCL_SIDEFX    read/write has side effects -- not architectural state
22	  EXCL_W1C_HW    write-1-clear, hardware-driven (like mip)
23	  EXCL_INDIRECT  miselect/mireg access mechanism, not a direct register
24	  EXCL_NEXT      U-mode N-extension trap state (trap-free ROI + usually absent)
25	  EXCL_DEBUG     Debug-mode CSR the handoff itself drives
26	  EXCL_MODE      S-mode / Hypervisor -- outside the M / M+U envelope
27	  EXCL_TRAP      detailed trap-cause latch, live only after a trap
28	
29	Usage:
30	  classify_csr_coverage.py <csr_inventory.csv>            # write csr_coverage.csv beside it
31	  classify_csr_coverage.py <csr_inventory.csv> --stdout   # print, do not write
32	"""
33	from __future__ import annotations
34	
35	import csv
36	import sys
37	from pathlib import Path
38	
39	# CSRs already carried in hybrid_state_v1 today (Bucket A). Names as the spec
40	# summary tables print them (range rows kept verbatim, e.g. pmpaddr1~63).
41	TRANSPORT_NOW = {
42	    "mstatus", "mepc", "mtvec", "mcause", "mtval", "mscratch", "medeleg",
43	    "mideleg", "mie", "mip", "mcycle", "minstret", "satp", "fcsr", "frm",
44	    "fﬂags",  # "fflags" with the fi-ligature the PDF emits
45	    "JVT", "mcache_ctl", "mmisc_ctl", "mxstatus", "mpft_ctl", "mclk_ctl",
46	    "milmb", "mdlmb", "mecc_code", "mhsp_ctl", "msp_bound", "msp_base",
47	    "mcountermask_m", "uitb", "ucode",
48	    "pmpcfg0", "pmpcfg1", "pmpcfg2", "pmpcfg3", "pmpcfg4~15",
49	    "pmpaddr0", "pmpaddr1~63",
50	    "pmacfg0", "pmacfg2", "pmaaddr0~47",
51	}
52	
53	# Per-name decisions that override the structural defaults below.
54	OVERRIDE = {
55	    "misa": "CONST_RO", "tinfo": "CONST_RO", "tdata3": "CONST_RO",
56	    "mintstatus": "EXCL_RO",
57	    # side-effecting: reading or writing performs an action, so the value is not
58	    # state to round-trip.
59	    "mnxti": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "mscratchcsw": "EXCL_SIDEFX",
60	    "mscratchcswl": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "mcctlcommand": "EXCL_SIDEFX",
61	    "mintsel_jal": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "pushmcause": "EXCL_SIDEFX",
62	    "pushmepc": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "pushmxstatus": "EXCL_SIDEFX",
63	    "wfe": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "txevt": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "ucctlcommand": "EXCL_SIDEFX",
64	    "mcounterovf": "EXCL_W1C_HW",
65	    "miselect": "EXCL_INDIRECT", "mireg": "EXCL_INDIRECT",
66	    "mireg2": "EXCL_INDIRECT", "mireg3": "EXCL_INDIRECT",
67	    "mireg4": "EXCL_INDIRECT", "mireg5": "EXCL_INDIRECT",
68	    "mireg6": "EXCL_INDIRECT",
69	    "dcsr": "EXCL_DEBUG", "dpc": "EXCL_DEBUG", "dscratch0": "EXCL_DEBUG",
70	    "dscratch1": "EXCL_DEBUG", "scontext": "EXCL_MODE",
71	    # writable M-mode plain state to add (the expansion).
72	    "menvcfg": "NEW", "mseccfg": "NEW", "mnscratch": "NEW", "mnepc": "NEW",
73	    "mncause": "NEW", "mnstatus": "NEW", "mnvec": "NEW", "mrnxvec": "NEW",
74	    "mtvt": "NEW", "mintthresh": "NEW", "mcounteren": "NEW",
75	    "mcountinhibit": "NEW", "mhpmcounter3~6": "NEW", "mhpmevent3~6": "NEW",
76	    "mcounterwen": "NEW", "mcounterinten": "NEW", "mcountermask_s": "NEW",
77	    "mcountermask_u": "NEW", "mdcause": "NEW", "mslideleg": "NEW",
78	    "msavestatus": "NEW", "msaveepc1": "NEW", "msavecause1": "NEW",
79	    "msaveepc2": "NEW", "msavecause2": "NEW", "msavedcause1": "NEW",
80	    "msavedcause2": "NEW", "mstateen0": "NEW", "mstateen1": "NEW",
81	    "mstateen2": "NEW", "mstateen3": "NEW", "mppib": "NEW", "mfiob": "NEW",
82	    "mﬁob": "NEW",  # fi-ligature variant the PDF emits
83	    "mcctlbeginaddr": "NEW", "mcctldata": "NEW", "mirq_entry": "NEW",
84	    "pmacfg4": "NEW", "pmacfg6": "NEW", "pmacfg8": "NEW", "pmacfg10": "NEW",
85	    "tselect": "NEW_TRIG", "mcontrol/tdata1": "NEW_TRIG", "tdata2": "NEW_TRIG",
86	    "tcontrol": "NEW_TRIG", "mcontext": "NEW_TRIG",
87	    "uzobctl": "NEW_UDELTA", "umisc_ctl": "NEW_UDELTA",
88	    "sleepvalue": "NEW_UDELTA", "ucctlbeginaddr": "NEW_UDELTA",
89	    "udcause": "EXCL_TRAP",
90	}
91	
92	RV32_ONLY = {
93	    "mcycleh", "minstreth", "mhpmcounter3h~6h", "mhpmevent3h~6h", "menvcfgh",
94	    "mseccfgh", "mstateen0h", "mstateen1h", "mstateen2h", "mstateen3h",
95	    "mcache_ctl2", "cycleh", "timeh", "instreth", "hpmcounter3h~6h",
96	    "pmacfg1", "pmacfg3", "pmacfg5", "pmacfg7", "pmacfg9", "pmacfg11",
97	}
98	
99	
100	def classify(addr, priv, name, mode, section):
101	    if name in TRANSPORT_NOW:
102	        return "TRANSPORT_NOW"
103	    if name in OVERRIDE:
104	        return OVERRIDE[name]
105	    if name in RV32_ONLY:
106	        return "EXCL_RV32"
107	    if mode in ("S-std", "S-andes", "H-std"):
108	        return "EXCL_MODE"
109	    if mode == "D-std" or name in ("dexc2dbg", "ddcause"):
110	        return "EXCL_DEBUG"
111	    if priv in ("MRO", "SRO", "URO", "DRO", "HRO"):
112	        return "CONST_RO"
113	    if mode == "U-std" and section == "N Extension CSRs":
114	        return "EXCL_NEXT"
115	    if mode == "U-std" and section == "Counter/Timer Registers":
116	        return "CONST_RO"
117	    raise SystemExit(f"unclassified CSR: {addr} {name} ({mode}/{section})")
118	
119	
120	def main(argv):
121	    if not argv:
122	        print(__doc__)
123	        return 2
124	    inv = Path(argv[0])
125	    to_stdout = "--stdout" in argv[1:]
126	    rows = list(csv.DictReader(inv.open()))
127	    out = [[r["addr"], r["priv"], r["name"], r["mode"], r["section"],
128	            classify(r["addr"], r["priv"], r["name"], r["mode"], r["section"])]
129	           for r in rows]
130	    if to_stdout:
131	        w = csv.writer(sys.stdout)
132	    else:
133	        dst = inv.with_name("csr_coverage.csv").open("w", newline="")
134	        w = csv.writer(dst)
135	    w.writerow(["addr", "priv", "name", "mode", "section", "decision"])
136	    w.writerows(out)
137	    if not to_stdout:
138	        print(f"wrote {inv.with_name('csr_coverage.csv')} ({len(out)} rows)")
139	    return 0
140	
141	
142	if __name__ == "__main__":
143	    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
144

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Completeness guard for the Andes-V5 CSR transport coverage (the flywheel).
3	
4	Cross-checks three artifacts and fails on any drift, so "nothing missed" is a
5	machine-checked invariant, not a hope:
6	
7	  1. csr_inventory.csv  -- the spec snapshot (every CSR in the SPA Chapter 5)
8	  2. csr_coverage.csv   -- each CSR's transport disposition (the matrix)
9	  3. include/hybrid/state_abi.h -- what the wire format ACTUALLY transports
10	
11	Checks (any failure exits non-zero):
12	  A. completeness  : matrix covers exactly the inventory's CSR set
13	  B. policy parity : re-running scripts/classify_csr_coverage.py reproduces the
14	                     committed matrix (offline policy == matrix)
15	  C. abi vs matrix : every CSR the ABI transports has a transport-disposition in
16	                     the matrix (never an excluded one), and every "carried
17	                     today" CSR is actually present in the ABI
18	
19	NEW/NEW_TRIG/NEW_UDELTA CSRs not yet in the ABI are reported as PENDING (the
20	ROADMAP backlog), not failures -- the guard tightens automatically as each
21	expansion feature lands and the CSR appears in the ABI.
22	
23	Usage: check_coverage.py [--abi PATH] [--quiet]
24	"""
25	from __future__ import annotations
26	
27	import argparse
28	import csv
29	import re
30	import sys
31	from pathlib import Path
32	
33	HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
34	ROOT = HERE.parent.parent
35	sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
36	import classify_csr_coverage as policy  # noqa: E402
37	
38	TRANSPORT = {"TRANSPORT_NOW", "NEW", "NEW_TRIG", "NEW_UDELTA"}
39	
40	# Standard CSRs named as direct scalar fields in struct hybrid_state_v1.
41	STD_FIELDS = {
42	    "mstatus", "mepc", "mtvec", "mcause", "mtval", "mscratch", "medeleg",
43	    "mideleg", "mip", "mie", "mcycle", "minstret", "satp", "fcsr",
44	    "mcache_ctl", "mmisc_ctl",
45	}
46	# Array groups: matrix rows whose name starts with one of these are transported
47	# as a block (pmpcfg[]/pmpaddr[]/pmacfg[]/pmaaddr[] in the ABI).
48	ARRAY_PREFIX = ("pmpcfg", "pmpaddr", "pmacfg", "pmaaddr")
49	# V CSRs are transported but defined by the RVV spec, not this SPA -> not in the
50	# inventory; exclude them from the ABI<->matrix cross-check.
51	V_NAMES = {"vstart", "vtype", "vl", "vlenb", "vxsat", "vxrm", "vcsr", "vreg"}
52	# CSRs carried inside a composite ABI field, not as their own field. fcsr packs
53	# frm[7:5] | fflags[4:0], so both round-trip via the single fcsr field.
54	COMPOSITE = {"fflags": "fcsr", "frm": "fcsr"}
55	
56	
57	def norm(name: str) -> str:
58	    """Canonical CSR name across representations (case, fi/fl ligatures)."""
59	    n = name.strip().lower()
60	    return n.replace("ﬂ", "fl").replace("ﬁ", "fi")
61	
62	
63	# gdb/ABI name -> spec name, where the wire format uses a different mnemonic.
64	ABI_ALIAS = {"mcirq_entry": "mirq_entry"}
65	
66	
67	def matrix_keys(name: str) -> set:
68	    """All names a matrix row can be referenced by: each '/'-alternate, and each
69	    member of a 'prefixN~M' range (so the ABI's individual mhpmcounter3 matches
70	    the spec's mhpmcounter3~6 row)."""
71	    keys = set()
72	    for part in name.split("/"):
73	        part = part.strip()
74	        m = re.match(r"^(.*?)(\d+)~(\d+)$", part)
75	        if m:
76	            pre, a, b = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
77	            for i in range(a, b + 1):
78	                keys.add(norm(pre + str(i)))
79	        keys.add(norm(part))
80	    return keys
81	
82	
83	def abi_macro_csrs(abi_text: str) -> set:
84	    """Normalized names from every X(field, addr, "name") in a *_CSR_LIST macro."""
85	    out = set()
86	    for m in re.finditer(r'X\(\s*(\w+)\s*,\s*0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+\s*,\s*"[^"]*"\s*\)',
87	                         abi_text):
88	        out.add(norm(m.group(1)))
89	    return out
90	
91	
92	def load(path: Path) -> list:
93	    return list(csv.DictReader(path.open()))
94	
95	
96	def main() -> int:
97	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
98	    ap.add_argument("--abi", default=str(ROOT / "include/hybrid/state_abi.h"))
99	    ap.add_argument("--quiet", action="store_true")
100	    args = ap.parse_args()
101	
102	    inv = load(HERE / "csr_inventory.csv")
103	    cov = load(HERE / "csr_coverage.csv")
104	    abi = Path(args.abi).read_text()
105	    errs: list = []
106	
107	    # A. completeness: matrix covers exactly the spec inventory.
108	    inv_addrs = [r["addr"] for r in inv]
109	    if sorted(r["addr"] for r in cov) != sorted(inv_addrs):
110	        errs.append("A: coverage CSR set != inventory CSR set")
111	    inv_key = {(r["addr"], r["name"]) for r in inv}
112	    cov_key = {(r["addr"], r["name"]) for r in cov}
113	    if inv_key != cov_key:
114	        miss = inv_key - cov_key
115	        extra = cov_key - inv_key
116	        errs.append(f"A: inventory/coverage row mismatch missing={miss} extra={extra}")
117	
118	    # B. policy parity: classify(inventory) reproduces the committed matrix.
119	    for ir, cr in zip(inv, cov):
120	        got = policy.classify(ir["addr"], ir["priv"], ir["name"], ir["mode"],
121	                              ir["section"])
122	        if got != cr["decision"]:
123	            errs.append(f"B: {ir['name']} classify={got} matrix={cr['decision']}")
124	
125	    # C. abi vs matrix.
126	    abi_names = abi_macro_csrs(abi) | {norm(n) for n in STD_FIELDS}
127	    cov_by_name = {}
128	    for r in cov:
129	        for k in matrix_keys(r["name"]):
130	            cov_by_name[k] = r["decision"]
131	    # forward: nothing the ABI transports may be an excluded CSR
132	    for an in sorted(abi_names):
133	        if an in V_NAMES:
134	            continue
135	        dec = cov_by_name.get(ABI_ALIAS.get(an, an))
136	        if dec is None:
137	            errs.append(f"C: ABI transports '{an}' but it is not in the matrix")
138	        elif dec not in TRANSPORT:
139	            errs.append(f"C: ABI transports '{an}' but matrix says {dec} (excluded)")
140	    # reverse: every carried-today CSR must be present in the ABI
141	    abi_spec_names = {ABI_ALIAS.get(n, n) for n in abi_names}
142	    pending = []
143	    for r in cov:
144	        nn = norm(r["name"])
145	        pref = next((p for p in ARRAY_PREFIX if nn.startswith(p)), None)
146	        in_abi = bool(matrix_keys(r["name"]) & abi_spec_names) \
147	            or (pref is not None and f"{pref}[" in abi) \
148	            or (COMPOSITE.get(nn) in abi_names)
149	        if r["decision"] == "TRANSPORT_NOW":
150	            if nn in V_NAMES:
151	                continue
152	            if not in_abi:
153	                errs.append(f"C: carried-today CSR '{r['name']}' missing from ABI")
154	        elif r["decision"] in TRANSPORT and not in_abi:
155	            pending.append(r["name"])
156	
157	    if errs:
158	        print("CSR COVERAGE GUARD: FAIL", file=sys.stderr)
159	        for e in errs:
160	            print("  - " + e, file=sys.stderr)
161	        return 1
162	    if not args.quiet:
163	        print(f"CSR coverage guard OK: {len(inv)} CSRs classified, "
164	              f"matrix==policy, ABI transports only matrix-approved CSRs")
165	        if pending:
166	            print(f"  PENDING (ROADMAP backlog, not yet in ABI): "
167	                  f"{len(pending)} -> {', '.join(pending)}")
168	    return 0
169	
170	
171	if __name__ == "__main__":
172	    sys.exit(main())
